signal: Onspring launched Onspring AI, a suite of GRC AI capabilities powered by Anthropic's Claude models, to generate documentation and summarize SOC 2 reports

email.body1:
Chad, saw Onspring launched Onspring AI, embedding Claude-powered capabilities across the GRC platform to draft documentation and summarize SOC 2 reports.

An AI launch like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the enterprise team can work, and reps end up buried in research instead of conversations. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Onspring off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Chad, quick follow-up for Onspring.

With Onspring AI sharpening the enterprise pitch, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover the addressable accounts. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Onspring needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chad, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Onspring's reply rate likely compares to other GRC vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chad, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Bringing a new AI suite to enterprise buyers keeps a sales team plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Onspring either way.
